data.one_liner: A collection of Flutter utility extensions, widgets, animations, and responsive helpers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a zero-external-dependency utility kit containing common Dart extensions, Flutter widgets, screen sizing helpers, and animation extensions. It consolidates multiple helper modules into a single importable package.
use_when: You want a collection of common UI widgets, animations, and type extensions without pulling in multiple external dependencies.
You need responsive screen sizing utilities like ScreenUtilInit and responsive extensions (.w, .h, .sp).
avoid_when: You only need one specific standalone helper and want to avoid adding a large utility suite.
You prefer keeping your extension methods minimal and strictly separated by concern.
strengths: Zero external dependencies apart from the Flutter SDK.
Modular imports allow reducing the compile surface for extensions, widgets, animations, and utils.
Includes extensive helper methods for Dart core types, widgets, and responsive sizing.
weaknesses: Blends many disparate features (animations, widgets, date/string extensions, map adapters) into a single package, making it broad rather than specialized.
Can lead to code bloat or naming collisions if not carefully imported.
